verdict.rationale: Otter documents an official MCP server that connects meeting data to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI chat tools. It supports searching transcripts across all time periods, retrieving action items and recaps, and analyzing themes across meetings. Access is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions, limited to meetings the user explicitly authorizes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as claimed, and in-depth technical docs (tool list, setup steps, confirmation of compatibility with arbitrary MCP clients beyond marketing and blog copy).
